label: muse_procrastinate_0#0
rationale: New-producer only with guaranteed retries: old worker must fetch and execute jobs deferred in new format, and retry bookkeeping written by one release must be readable by the other on the second attempt.

label: muse_procrastinate_0#1
rationale: Old-producer flaky jobs that fail on old and succeed on new plus new-admin retry of job 2 which also only succeeds on new: forces old-to-new retry handoff and checks new retry records are executable while old worker is still polling.

label: muse_procrastinate_0#2
rationale: Bidirectional flaky handoff: old-deferred job fails on old/succeeds on new and new-deferred job fails on new/succeeds on old, so success requires cross-release retry; concurrent new-admin retries of both earlier jobs stress administered-status transitions under concurrency.

label: muse_procrastinate_0#3
rationale: Symmetric fail/ok load from both producers plus new-admin retry of always-fail job 1: checks both defer directions and that fail-retry-failed state machine stays consistent when deferred, retried and reaped by different releases.
